meaning.en: Brihadratha (the king's name)
having settled his eldest son in the kingdom
meaning.hi: अपने बड़े पुत्र को राज्य में स्थापित करके

meaning.en: regarding this as not lasting
turning to renunciation regarding the body
meaning.hi: शरीर के प्रति वैराग्य को प्राप्त होकर

meaning.en: went out into the forest
undertaking the highest austerity
gazing at the sun, standing with arms raised
meaning.hi: सूर्य को देखते हुए, भुजाएँ ऊपर उठाए खड़े रहते हैं

meaning.en: at the end of a thousand (years)
a sage approached

words.sanskrit: agnih iva adhumakah tejasa nirdahan iva

meaning.en: like a smokeless fire, seeming to burn all around with radiance
meaning.hi: बिना धुएँ की अग्नि जैसे, तेज से जैसे सब जला रहे हों

meaning.en: the revered self-knower Shakayanya
"get up, get up, choose a boon"
he bowed to him and said
"Lord, I do not know the self"
"we have heard you know the true nature of things"
meaning.hi: "हमने सुना है आप तत्त्व को जानते हैं"

meaning.en: "please tell it to us"
this matter has traditionally been considered impossible/too difficult
meaning.hi: यह बात पहले से असम्भव मानी गई है

meaning.en: "do not ask this question"
"choose some other ordinary wish, as the Ikshvaku kings do"
meaning.hi: "इक्ष्वाकु राजाओं की भाँति कोई अन्य इच्छा माँगो"

meaning.en: touching Shakayanya's feet
meaning.hi: शाकायन्य के चरणों को स्पर्श करते हुए

meaning.en: the king spoke this verse
"so what use are these"
the drying up of the great oceans
the falling of mountain peaks
the wavering of the pole star
the sinking of trees from their place
meaning.hi: वृक्षों का अपने स्थान से धँसना

meaning.en: the shifting of the gods' ground from its place
meaning.hi: देवताओं की भूमि का अपने स्थान से खिसकना

meaning.en: in this kind of world of change, thinking 'I am this'
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार के संसार में 'मैं यह हूँ' ऐसा मानते हुए

meaning.en: "what use is the enjoyment of desires"
for one who takes refuge in them, repeated return (rebirth) is seen
meaning.hi: जिनका आश्रय लेने वाले के लिए बार-बार लौटना देखा जाता है

meaning.en: "you alone are worthy to lift me out"
like a frog stuck in a blind (dried-up) well
meaning.hi: अन्धे (सूखे) कुएँ में फँसे मेंढक की तरह

meaning.en: "I am in this cycle of existence"
"Lord, you alone are our refuge"
"Lord, this body"
arisen from union (of parents)
devoid of consciousness (in its raw material)
like a cesspit/hell itself
departing through the urinary passage
built up with bones
plastered with flesh
bound/wrapped with skin
with feces, urine, wind, bile, phlegm, marrow, fat
meaning.hi: मल, मूत्र, वायु, पित्त, कफ, मज्जा, चर्बी से

meaning.en: and filled with many other impurities besides
meaning.hi: और अन्य कई मलों से भरा हुआ

meaning.en: for one who lives on within a body like this
meaning.hi: ऐसे शरीर में रहने वाले के लिए

meaning.en: "Lord, you alone are our refuge"

words.sanskrit: atha bhagavan shakayanyah suprito abravit rajanam

meaning.en: then the revered Shakayanya, deeply pleased, said to the king
meaning.hi: तब भगवान शाकायन्य अत्यन्त प्रसन्न होकर राजा से बोले

meaning.en: great king Brihadratha, banner-head of the Ikshvaku dynasty
meaning.hi: महाराज बृहद्रथ, इक्ष्वाकु वंश की ध्वजा-शीर्ष

meaning.en: you have become one who knows the self, one whose task is accomplished
meaning.hi: तुम आत्मज्ञ, कृतकृत्य हो गए हो

meaning.en: you are famed by the name Marut
meaning.hi: तुम मरुत् नाम से विख्यात हो

meaning.en: this indeed is the self that is yours (to ask about)
meaning.hi: यही निश्चय ही तुम्हारा वह आत्मा है

meaning.en: "which one, revered one, should be described?"
to him he then spoke
the mind alone, indeed, is this cycle of existence
meaning.hi: मन ही, निश्चय ही, यह संसार है

meaning.en: one should purify it through careful effort
whatever the mind dwells on, one becomes made of that
meaning.hi: मन जिसमें रमा रहता है, वैसा ही बन जाता है

meaning.en: this is a hidden, eternal truth
meaning.hi: यह एक गूढ़, शाश्वत रहस्य है

meaning.en: through the clarity/settling of the mind
one destroys both good and bad action
meaning.hi: शुभ और अशुभ दोनों कर्म नष्ट होते हैं

meaning.en: with a clear self, established in the self
meaning.hi: प्रसन्न आत्मा, आत्मा में स्थित होकर

meaning.en: one enjoys imperishable happiness
meaning.hi: अक्षय सुख को प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: when the mind becomes tightly attached
meaning.hi: जब मन गहराई से आसक्त होता है

meaning.en: of a being, within the range of sense-objects
meaning.hi: प्राणी का, इन्द्रिय-विषयों के दायरे में

meaning.en: if it were fixed this same way on brahman
meaning.hi: यदि यह इसी तरह ब्रह्म में स्थिर हो

meaning.en: then who would not be freed from bondage?
meaning.hi: तो कौन बन्धन से मुक्त न हो?

meaning.en: in the middle of the heart's lotus
one should meditate on the supreme Lord
the witness of the intellect's activity
reachable only through supreme love
meaning.hi: जो केवल परम प्रेम से ही ग्राह्य है

meaning.en: beyond the range of mind and speech
meaning.hi: मन और वाणी की पहुँच से परे

meaning.en: beyond even the states reached by renunciates and the like
meaning.hi: अवधूत आदि की अवस्थाओं से भी परे

meaning.en: the single light shining as pure existence itself
meaning.hi: सत्तामात्र के प्रकाश रूप एकमात्र प्रकाश

meaning.en: beyond what imagination can construct
not to be given up, not to be taken up
meaning.hi: न त्यागने योग्य, न ग्रहण करने योग्य

meaning.en: without ordinary distinguishing qualities
constant, still and profound
neither light nor darkness stretched out
meaning.hi: न तेज, न अन्धकार फैला हुआ

meaning.en: beyond all distinctions, beyond all appearance
a pure awareness that is itself the deepest peace
eternal, pure, awake, free by its own nature
meaning.hi: नित्य, शुद्ध, बुद्ध, स्वभाव से मुक्त

meaning.en: true, subtle, all-pervading, and without a second
who is the supreme ocean of bliss
I am that
the innermost self - in this there is no doubt
meaning.hi: प्रत्यक् आत्मा - इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं

meaning.en: the joy that is one's own inner refuge
meaning.hi: वह आन्तरिक, अपना आनन्द जो शरण है

meaning.en: one who has stripped the demoness false-hope of her power
meaning.hi: जिसने आशा-रूपी राक्षसी को शक्तिहीन कर दिया

meaning.en: watching the world as a magician's illusion
meaning.hi: संसार को इन्द्रजाल की तरह देखते हुए

meaning.en: how could trouble ever enter one who is unattached?
meaning.hi: विपत्ति असंग व्यक्ति में कैसे प्रवेश कर सकती है?

meaning.en: those confused, bound to caste and stage-of-life practice
meaning.hi: वर्णाश्रम आचार में उलझे हुए मूढ़

meaning.en: receive results strictly according to their actions
meaning.hi: कर्म के अनुसार ही फल पाते हैं

meaning.en: those who let go entirely of duties like caste
meaning.hi: जो वर्ण आदि धर्म को पूरी तरह त्याग देते हैं

meaning.en: become people satisfied by their own inner joy
meaning.hi: अपने आनन्द से तृप्त पुरुष बन जाते हैं

meaning.en: the caste-and-stage system, with its many parts, its own nature
meaning.hi: वर्णाश्रम, अपने अंगों सहित, अपना स्वरूप

meaning.en: having a beginning and end, indeed no more than a demanding discipline
meaning.hi: आदि-अन्त सहित, अत्यन्त कठिन अनुशासन मात्र

meaning.en: becoming free of pride tied to the body of a son and the like
meaning.hi: पुत्र आदि के शरीर के प्रति अभिमान-शून्य होकर

meaning.en: one should dwell in that state of supreme, boundless happiness
meaning.hi: उस परम, अनन्त सुख में निवास करना चाहिए

meaning.en: then the revered Maitreya went to Kailasa
having gone there, he said
"revered one, please teach me the secret of the highest truth"
then the revered Maitreya went again to Kailasa
meaning.hi: तब भगवान मैत्रेय फिर कैलास गए

meaning.en: having arrived there, he said
"revered one, please teach me the secret of the highest truth"
one should drink the nectar of brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म के अमृत का पान करना चाहिए

meaning.en: one should beg for food, for the sake of sustaining the body
meaning.hi: देह-रक्षा के लिए भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए

meaning.en: one should live having become solitary
and in solitude free of duality
a wise person should practice this way
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति इस प्रकार आचरण करे

meaning.en: he thereby attains liberation
meaning.hi: वह इस प्रकार मुक्ति प्राप्त करे

meaning.en: this body is born, this body dies
meaning.hi: यह शरीर जन्मता है, यह शरीर मरता है

meaning.en: made of the impurity of mother and father
a storehouse of pleasure and pain, unclean
having touched it, bathing is prescribed
bound by the elements, a great disease
a home for sin, impermanent
spread wide in form with disorder
meaning.hi: विकार के आकार से फैला हुआ

meaning.en: having touched it, bathing is prescribed
leaking impurity through nine openings
always, by its own inherent nature
foul-smelling, filled with filth
having touched it, bathing is prescribed
connected to the mother's birth-impurity
one is born together with that impurity
meaning.hi: सूतक के साथ ही जन्म लेता है

meaning.en: the body born of death-impurity too
having touched it, bathing is prescribed
freedom from 'I' and 'mine,' from the smell of feces, urine and such clinging impurity
meaning.hi: 'मैं' और 'मेरा' से, मल-मूत्र आदि की गन्ध से मुक्ति

meaning.en: this is declared to be true purity
meaning.hi: यही सच्ची शुद्धता कही गई है

meaning.en: purity by mud and water is merely worldly
meaning.hi: मिट्टी-जल से शुद्धि तो लौकिक है

meaning.en: purity that purifies the mind
destroying the three deep-rooted dispositions
meaning.hi: तीन वासनाओं का नाश करने वाली

meaning.en: from washing with the earth and water of knowledge and dispassion
meaning.hi: ज्ञान-वैराग्य रूपी मिट्टी-जल से धोने से

meaning.en: this is called true purity
alms gathered while resting in non-dual awareness
not fit to eat, if gathered in the sense of duality
in the spirit spoken of by guru and scripture
alms for the renunciate are thus prescribed
meaning.hi: भिक्षु की भिक्षा इस प्रकार विहित है

meaning.en: the learned person, having abandoned their own homeland
immediately after renunciation, of their own accord
meaning.hi: संन्यास के तुरन्त बाद, स्वयं ही

meaning.en: should live far away, like a thief freed from prison
meaning.hi: कारागार से मुक्त चोर की तरह दूर रहे

meaning.en: ego like a son, wealth like a brother
delusion, a home one has built
as long as one has not renounced false hope like a wife
meaning.hi: जब तक आशा-रूपी पत्नी को न त्यागे

meaning.en: until then, no doubt they are not liberated
meaning.hi: तब तक मुक्त नहीं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं

meaning.en: the mother made of delusion has died
a son made of awareness has been born
when two kinds of birth-impurity arrive together
meaning.hi: दो सूतक एक साथ आने पर

meaning.en: how could one perform the evening worship?
in the sky of the heart, the sun of consciousness
always shines, always shines
meaning.hi: सदा चमकता है, सदा चमकता है

meaning.en: it neither sets nor rises
meaning.hi: न अस्त होता है, न उदय होता है

meaning.en: how could one perform the evening worship?
that which is the one reality without a second
settled through the guru's own words
this alone is called true solitude
meaning.hi: इसे ही एकान्त कहा गया है

meaning.en: not a monastery, not a remote forest
for those free of doubt, liberation
for those whose minds are possessed by doubt
meaning.hi: सन्देह से घिरे चित्त वालों के लिए

meaning.en: no liberation, even after birth after birth
therefore one should attain settled trust
renunciation is not the giving up of action
nor by the utterance of a formal declaration
the union of the individual self and innermost self in agreement
that is what is truly called renunciation
for whom, like vomited food
meaning.hi: जिसके लिए वमन किए भोजन जैसा

meaning.en: every desire appears (repulsive)
that person is qualified for renunciation
having let go of pride tied to the body

words.sanskrit: yada manasi vairagyam jatam sarveshu vastushu

meaning.en: when dispassion has arisen in the mind toward all things
meaning.hi: जब मन में सब वस्तुओं में वैराग्य उत्पन्न हो

meaning.en: then alone should the learned one renounce
otherwise, he falls

words.sanskrit: dravya-artham anna-vastra-artham yah pratishtha-artham eva va

meaning.en: one who renounces for wealth, food, clothes, or fame
meaning.hi: जो धन, भोजन, वस्त्र या प्रतिष्ठा के लिए संन्यास ले

meaning.en: such a renunciate falls from both
meaning.hi: वह दोनों ओर से भ्रष्ट होता है

meaning.en: he is not fit to attain liberation
the best is contemplation of the highest truth
the middling is study of scripture
the low is contemplation through mantra
wandering to pilgrimage sites is lowest of the low
without direct experience, the fool
takes empty delight in brahman
meaning.hi: व्यर्थ ही ब्रह्म में आनन्दित होता है

meaning.en: like the delight of tasting a fruit reflected at a branch's tip
meaning.hi: शाखाग्र पर प्रतिबिम्बित फल के स्वाद के आनन्द के समान

meaning.en: the liberated renunciate should not abandon
begging, which is like a mother
meaning.hi: भिक्षा, जो माता के समान है

meaning.en: dispassion the father who begets, faith the wife, knowledge the son
meaning.hi: वैराग्य पिता, श्रद्धा पत्नी, ज्ञान पुत्र

words.sanskrit: dhana-vriddhah vayo-vriddhah vidya-vriddhah tatha eva cha

meaning.en: those grown in wealth, those grown in age, and likewise those grown in learning
all of them are servants of one grown in wisdom
meaning.hi: वे सब ज्ञान-वृद्ध के सेवक हैं

meaning.en: and disciples are his servants too
those whose minds are bewildered by illusion
meaning.hi: जिनका चित्त माया से मोहित है

meaning.en: not attaining their own complete self
meaning.hi: अपनी पूर्ण आत्मा को न पाकर

words.sanskrit: param vidagdha-udara-purnaya bhramanti kakah iva surayah api

meaning.en: even the wise wander like crows, to fill their bellies
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमान भी पेट भरने को कौवों की तरह भटकते हैं

meaning.en: worship offered to images of stone, metal, gem, or clay
meaning.hi: पत्थर, धातु, रत्न, मिट्टी की मूर्तियों में पूजा

meaning.en: brings rebirth and continued experience for the seeker of liberation
meaning.hi: मुमुक्षु के लिए पुनर्जन्म-भोग करने वाली

meaning.en: the renunciate should worship only within their own heart
meaning.hi: यति अपने हृदय में ही अर्चना करे

meaning.en: and give up external worship, for the sake of never being reborn
meaning.hi: पुनर्भव न हो इसके लिए बाह्य अर्चना त्यागे

meaning.en: full within, full without
like a full jar in the ocean
meaning.hi: समुद्र में भरे घड़े की तरह

meaning.en: empty within, empty without
like an empty jar in the sky
meaning.hi: आकाश में खाली घड़े की तरह

meaning.en: do not become the nature of the object grasped
and do not become the grasping self either
having abandoned every mental construction entirely
become that which genuinely remains
meaning.hi: जो शेष रहे उसी में तन्मय हो जाओ

meaning.en: having abandoned seer, seeing and seen along with their tendencies
meaning.hi: द्रष्टा, दर्शन, दृश्य को वासना सहित त्यागकर

meaning.en: worship only the self, the first glimmer of seeing
meaning.hi: दर्शन के प्रथम आभास रूप आत्मा की ही आराधना करो

meaning.en: in which every mental construction has completely quieted
meaning.hi: जिसमें सब संकल्प पूर्णतः शान्त हो गए

meaning.en: a steadiness like that of a stone
free from both waking and sleep
that is the supreme abiding in one's own true nature
I am, I am the supreme beyond
meaning.hi: मैं हूँ, मैं परम से परे हूँ

meaning.en: I am brahman, I am the source
meaning.hi: मैं ब्रह्म हूँ, मैं उद्गम हूँ

meaning.en: and I am the teacher of all worlds
meaning.hi: और मैं सब लोकों का गुरु हूँ

meaning.en: I am present in all worlds, I am that
meaning.hi: मैं सब लोकों में हूँ, मैं वही हूँ

meaning.en: I alone am, I am perfected
meaning.hi: मैं ही हूँ, मैं सिद्ध हूँ

meaning.en: I am pure, I am the highest
meaning.hi: मैं शुद्ध हूँ, मैं सर्वोच्च हूँ

meaning.en: I am the moon, I am eternal, I am utterly stainless
meaning.hi: मैं सोम हूँ, मैं नित्य हूँ, मैं निर्मल हूँ

meaning.en: I am true wisdom, I am unique
meaning.hi: मैं विज्ञान हूँ, मैं विशेष हूँ

meaning.en: I am the moon, I am whole
meaning.hi: मैं सोम हूँ, मैं सकल हूँ

meaning.en: I am auspicious, free of grief, consciousness, equanimity itself
meaning.hi: मैं शुभ हूँ, शोकहीन, चैतन्य, सम हूँ

meaning.en: free of honor and dishonor, without qualities, auspicious
free of duality and non-duality, free of every pair, I am that
meaning.hi: द्वैत-अद्वैत रहित, द्वन्द्व रहित, मैं वही हूँ

meaning.en: free of existence and non-existence, without radiance, yet I am radiance
meaning.hi: भाव-अभाव रहित, भासहीन, फिर भी मैं भा हूँ

meaning.en: beyond emptiness and non-emptiness, beyond beautiful and ugly
meaning.hi: शून्य-अशून्य से परे, शोभन-अशोभन से परे

meaning.en: beyond comparable and incomparable, eternal, pure, ever auspicious
beyond thing and non-thing, I am pure being, always that
meaning.hi: सर्व-असर्व रहित, मैं सात्त्विक हूँ, सदा वही

meaning.en: beyond the count of one, and carrying no vehicle counted as two
meaning.hi: एक-संख्या रहित, दो-संख्या का वाहन भी नहीं

meaning.en: free of the distinction between is and is not, free of all mental construction
free of the distinction between individual selves, a form of undivided bliss

words.sanskrit: na aham asmi na cha anyo'smi deha-adi-rahito'smyaham

meaning.en: I am not this ordinary 'I', nor simply another, free of the body and all it entails
meaning.hi: न मैं हूँ, न अन्य हूँ, देह आदि रहित

meaning.en: free of the relation of support and supported, without a foundation
free of bondage and liberation, I am pure brahman, I am that
meaning.hi: बन्ध-मोक्ष आदि रहित, शुद्ध ब्रह्म, मैं वही हूँ

meaning.en: free of mind and all its constructions, the highest beyond the highest
meaning.hi: चित्त आदि सर्व रहित, परम से भी परे

meaning.en: always in the form of reflection, yet beyond reflection, I am that
meaning.hi: सदा विचार-रूप, फिर भी निर्विचार, मैं वही हूँ

meaning.en: the form of the sounds a and u, the m-sound, eternal (the syllable Om)
free of meditation on the creator, free of anything to meditate upon, I am that
meaning.hi: धातृ-ध्यान रहित, ध्येय रहित, मैं वही हूँ

meaning.en: of a form completely full, marked by existence-consciousness-bliss
the form of every sacred site, I am the supreme self, auspicious
meaning.hi: सर्वतीर्थ स्वरूप, मैं परमात्मा हूँ, शिव

meaning.en: beyond aimable and unaimable, a flavor free of dissolving
beyond the measurer and the measure, beyond the measured, auspicious
not the seer of the entire world, free of eyes and the rest
meaning.hi: न जगत् का सर्व-द्रष्टा, नेत्र आदि रहित

meaning.en: fully developed, fully awakened, at peace, beyond the highest
free of every sense organ, yet the doer of every action
satisfied by the essence of all scripture, always easily found
known as delight and beyond delight, the fruit of all silent discipline
eternally of the nature of pure consciousness, always made of being-consciousness

words.sanskrit: yat-kinchit api hino'smi svalpam api na asmyaham

meaning.en: not lacking in even the slightest, nor am I even a little excessive
meaning.hi: किंचित् भी हीन नहीं, थोड़ा भी अधिक नहीं

meaning.en: free of the heart's knot, seated in the middle of the heart's lotus
free of the six changes, free of the six sheaths
liberated from the six inner enemies, inward beyond the inward
free of place and time, the joy of going without clothing
not this, not this, free even of the word 'not'
the form of unbroken space, indeed an unbroken shape
a mind free of the illusory world, free of that world entirely
the form of every illumination, the light of pure consciousness
free of the three divisions of time, free of desire and the like
free of the bodily and the like, without qualities, alone
beyond needing liberation, liberated, beyond liberation, always
free of true and false, always more than mere existence
meaning.hi: सत्य-असत्य आदि रहित, सन्मात्र से भी अधिक सदा

meaning.en: free of any place to travel to, free of coming and going
always of the same form, at peace, the supreme being

words.sanskrit: evam sva-anubhavo yasya sah aham asmi na samshayah

meaning.en: whoever has this as their own direct experience is, without doubt, me
meaning.hi: जिसका ऐसा स्वानुभव है, वह मैं ही हूँ, सन्देह नहीं

meaning.en: whoever hears this even a single time
meaning.hi: जो एक बार भी सुनता है

words.sanskrit: brahma eva bhavati svayam iti upanishat

meaning.en: becomes brahman itself - thus the secret teaching (Upanishad)
meaning.hi: स्वयं ब्रह्म बन जाता है - यही उपनिषद्
